properties.name: Chandigarh (UT) — Operational Area
properties.note: IMPORTANT: This is a SIMPLIFIED, hand-built approximation of the Chandigarh Union Territory boundary, constructed from publicly documented reference points (UT area ~114 sq km; city center ~30.7333N 76.7794E; known edge landmarks). It is NOT an official cadastral/survey boundary and should NOT be presented to users as authoritative. Before relying on this for anything beyond MVP/demo geofencing, replace it with an authoritative source, e.g.: (1) Survey of India / Chandigarh Administration open data if available, or (2) an OpenStreetMap extract via Overpass API: `[out:json];relation["boundary"="administrative"]["name"="Chandigarh"];out geom;` run from a machine with open internet access (this sandbox's network is allowlisted and can't reach Overpass/Nominatim directly).
